description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git rebase'. It includes multiple test cases, setup commands, and assertions to verify rebase functionality, author preservation, conflict handling, and other features within the Git version control system.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file output.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev
methods.description: Compares two revisions to verify sameness or difference.

methods.name: test_cfg
methods.description: Sets a configuration value for testing.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new repository for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of a test suite.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Runs a command where failure is acceptable.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock to simulate passage of time.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
